claim: Population Dynamics: the hypothesis that spike shape 'averages out' in a coupled crowd — which the bundle's own measurement found half wrong (shape stops mattering to when the crowd locks, not to how it sounds; locking darkens every shape). Also The Four Stages: fixed spike duration darkens the tone as pitch rises.

pieces.what: Four spike shapes, each played scattered then locked at matched loudness, with the three-panel figure beside them; the reader hears each shape keep its colour through the lock. This is the test of the section's own hypothesis, already made.
The four stages as a walk, each a playable oscillator; at Stage 3 a pitch sweep against the fixed 1 ms spike lets the reader hear the darkening and hit the ceiling.
pieces.walks_up_from: Stage 1: the membrane as capacitor, a sawtooth

pieces.what: The eight-panel interactive document, gathered as is.
